test_title: PYST 15: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 16th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following question, select the word which cannot be formed using the letters of the given word.

ENTERTAINMENT
solution:
Now check each option:

 
• ENTER → E, N, T, E, R (all letters available)
 
• TENT → T, E, N, T 
 
• RENT → R, E, N, T 
 
• LANE → L, A, N, E (L is not present in ENTERTAINMENT)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**
